name: Newfoundland and Labrador
short: If you heat with oil or propane, the Oil to Electric program pays up to $22,000 to switch to a central heat pump when your income qualifies, or up to $9,000 if not, and pays your installer directly. Homes already on electric heat get takeCHARGE rebates of up to $3,000 for insulation and $750 for air sealing. Lower-income homes can apply for no-cost upgrades, and oil buyers can get $400 to $1,000 from the Home Heating Supplement this winter.

rows.upgrade: Oil or propane to heat pump

250 litres of oil. Income $150,000 or less. Apply by Jan 15, 2027.
